newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaves Dhaka for New Delhi on Friday to attend an inter-parliamentary conference.
Hundreds of farmers in southwestern district of Jhenidah barricaded a highway on Wednesday for one-and-a-half hour demanding smooth supply of fertiliser.
Former President Hussain Moahammad Ershad has said he has no lust for power and wants to live the rest of his life as "premier" of Rangpur who voted him to the parliament.
The Indian Airlines introduced on Wednesday its air bus service in the Calcutta-Chittagong route.
China has welcomed the proposed sub-regional cooperation among Bangladesh, India, Nepal and Bhutan.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will visit Pakistan on March 23 to attend a meeting of the Organisation of Islamic Conference.
U.S. President Clinton said on Tuesday political and economic situation in Bangladesh was good.
Bangladesh will hold a week-long trade show in Kathmandu from February 28.
